notes: CAMPAIGN COMPLETE: all 12 missions of FIRST HARVEST are here, from the raid on the Green Coast Collective to the night Blackwell fell. It leads straight into ZOMBIES chapter one.

3 PAPER TRAIL: tail a courier through Vernon Square, crack the lockers, decrypt the drive, run the metro tunnel. 4 HIGH RISE: silent takedowns on the Lazarus tower roof, find Doc, hold the helipad, THE WARDEN.

5 PURPLE DUST: crop samples, burn the Nightshade fields, a sniper duel with HAWK, blow the pump, beat the dust storm. 6 COLD STORAGE: cut the power, sneak through the dark, break Tank out, steal the seed case.

7 THE PASS: mine the river crossings, overwatch, hit the convoy, protect Tank, THE HOUND. 8 WHEELS UP: meet Sparks, restore the airport power, scan the cargo, catch the loader, blow the plane's cargo.
9 THE WORKS: the graveyard, the bottling lines, Harold's safe, THE FOREMAN, out through the fire. 10 SOURCE: the Grower's journal, walk him to his lighthouse, burn the first field.
11 LAST STAND: fortify the hideout, guard the grow tent, stop the saboteurs, COMMANDER RHYS. 12 LIGHTS OUT: Blackwell Hospital, the vents, HAROLD VOSS and the first infected.
FIX: the traffic lights at VERNON SQUARE were broken (invisible).
